tooltip.copypoly.edit: Sneak + right-click to edit. Apply materials like a Create copycat.
screen.copypoly.title: Copycat Polyhedron
screen.copypoly.drag: Click: select • Drag empty space: rotate • Scroll: zoom
screen.copypoly.add_hint: Click a surface to place a grid point. Invalid shapes use block bounds. Esc: cancel
screen.copypoly.move_hint: Drag XYZ arrows • Click again: deselect • Delete: remove
screen.copypoly.add_tooltip: Click a surface to add a point, then drag its arrows. Interior or coplanar points may not change the convex hull.
screen.copypoly.move_tooltip: Red X: east; green Y: up; blue Z: south. Gray axes point toward the camera: rotate the view or edit the coordinate fields. Right-drag rotates anywhere.
screen.copypoly.delete_tooltip: Delete the selected point from the shape.
screen.copypoly.error.range: Coordinates must be integers from 0 to 16.
screen.copypoly.error.flat: Points must enclose a volume, not just a plane.
screen.copypoly.error.format: Each line needs three integers: x, y, z.
screen.copypoly.error.duplicate: A point already occupies this position. Choose another coordinate.
screen.copypoly.error.surface: Click a surface of the shape, or the block bounds if the shape is invalid.
screen.copypoly.error.permission: You cannot edit this block here.
screen.copypoly.error.changed: Shape changed elsewhere. Reopen the editor.
screen.copypoly.error.busy: Please wait a moment and apply again.
